evidence.claim: The flagged transaction 3503878 is an online purchase with a high model score of 0.784 (historical fraud rate 78%) and is the first transaction for this holder identity.

The transaction was made using device D008254, which is new to the card and was used by 5 different cards in the past week, all generating suspicious transactions (model score > 0.5), resulting in a fraud lift of 48.43.
Device D008254 directly links this transaction to cards C11309-K1 and C06224-K2, which are members of known fraud rings 34603052 and 37749036 with extensive confirmed fraud histories.
Card C07987-K2 has a history of confirmed fraud, including a prior card-not-present fraud case CC-2860.

case.summary: On December 1, 2016, an online transaction for $99.92 was flagged due to a high real-time risk score. The transaction was made using a new device (D008254) that was shared across five different cards in the past week, generating a high fraud lift. This device directly links the transaction to known fraud rings, and the subject card itself has a history of confirmed card-not-present fraud. Given the strong device links to known fraud and the high model score, the transaction is confirmed as card-not-present fraud.

sar.narrative: This report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C07987 and card C07987-K2. On December 1, 2016, an online transaction totaling $99.92 was attempted in region 264. The transaction was conducted using device D008254, identified as a Windows system running Chrome 61.0. This device was new to the account and has been linked to five different cards within a one-week window, generating highly suspicious activity. Furthermore, device D008254 directly connects this activity to cards C11309-K1 and C06224-K2, which are associated with known fraud rings. The subject card, C07987-K2, also has a history of confirmed card-not-present fraud. The use of a shared device connected to established fraud rings, combined with the high model score of the transaction, indicates a coordinated effort to exploit compromised card details. The total exposure for this episode is $99.92.

stop_reason: The investigation was stopped because the probability of fraud reached 0.95, exceeding the decisive threshold of 0.85 under Section 6, supported by multiple independent pieces of evidence including a shared device linked to known fraud rings and a prior confirmed fraud case on the card.
